title: Destination Perpetuity | Craig O'Rourke | Talks at Google
description:
Author, investor and real estate professional Craig O'Rourke shares his fresh, direct and common sense approach to real estate investing. In this powerful Google Talk, Craig explains his theory of why intelligent real estate investing is by far the best way to build true wealth in today's complex and often confusing investor marketplace. Craig explains how to create a personal cash flow of annuity by building a portfolio of self-funding, self-sustaining income producing real estate.

Get the book here: https://goo.gl/ef6JGx
